narrative_purpose: Capture the chapter's essence at a glance: one Na'vi figure alone on a vast dead ash plain beneath a venting volcanic ridge — a people living on a landscape that will not recover in their lifetime.
subject: A single tall blue-skinned Na'vi figure in dark hide-and-bone clothing standing small against an immense grey volcanic ash plain, back partly to the viewer, surveying the desolation. The figure is the only living thing in sight.
scene: A barren ashland stretching to a distant venting volcanic ridge on the horizon, thin sulfurous fumarole plumes rising, the calcined skeletons of a few giant trees scattered across the grey plain, a dim ashen sky with faint high haze.
camera: Wide establishing shot, low horizon, the lone figure placed off-centre and small to emphasise the scale of the dead land.
light: Overcast diffuse light, no bright sun; the faint warm ember-amber glow of distant lava venting on the ridge is the only warm accent against a cool grey-indigo scene.
palette: Desaturated stone-grey and indigo dominate the ash and sky; one restrained ember-amber vent glow on the far ridge as the single warm focus.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, bleak and observed, not dramatic action art.
detail_level: Crisp figure and nearest tree skeletons; the plain and ridge dissolve into atmospheric grey haze.
composition: Vast horizontal emptiness, the small figure low and to one side, generous dead negative space, a low venting ridge across the far third.
consistency_notes: A grim volcanic wasteland on Pandora: grey tephra, calcined tree skeletons, distant venting ridge. The mood is desolation and endurance, not spectacle. Cool grey-indigo dominant with a single small warm vent glow.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no green rainforest, no neon glow, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style, no dramatic explosion
